verdict_prior_art: SASI standalone instrument: identification artifacts only (TrID/wikidata) + module-format source (nuade/UADE). No standalone-instrument parser found anywhere as of 2026-11-12; dexvert 'No known converter' note is CURRENT. The 672-byte SASI census below is, to our knowledge, the first public structural write-up.

findings.value: 672 B = 8-byte magic 'SASI\0\0\0\0' + 152-byte instrument record + 4 x 128-byte tables (8+152+512=672). EXACT on 36/36 files

byte layout IDENTICAL to the per-instrument INST entry inside SA modules (nuade reader layout): type/waveform_number/waveform_length/repeat_length u16s, 8 reserved, volume(+16, 0-64), fine_tuning(i8), portamento, vibrato delay/speed/level, amf number/delay/length/repeat, adsr number/delay/length/repeat, sustain point/delay, 16 reserved, effect arg1/effect/arg2/arg3/delay, 3 arpeggios {len,repeat,14xi8}, 30-byte NUL-padded name at record offset 122 (= file offset 130)
findings.status: RESOLVED (cross-validated against real module 'time to death.sa': 4 records x 152 B parsed, same field ranges)

findings.value: type=1 (synth) in 36/36; waveform_length in {1,16,32,64}; volume 30..64; vibrato_delay 0..255 or 65535(off); effect args 0..127 plus 65408=0xFF80; instrument names match file names (some truncated/aliased e.g. 'Bell's\0--')
waveform, signed 8-bit: Light_Sine = textbook sine; Acomp_Bass = ramp; snare = noise; nonzero bytes = 2..128, correlates with waveform_length
ADSR/amplitude table, values 0..64 (Amiga volume scale), 128 entries; present in 36/36
AMF-style modulation table, signed/63-centered sine-shaped curves; nonzero in only ~5/36 instruments
second waveform-like signed table (square/noise shapes, 0..128 nonzero); exact role unverified - candidates: synth-effect waveform / morph target (cf. 'SineMorf')
SA directory file: stride-44 entries = 42-byte NUL-padded name + u16 BE size (0x02A0 = 672); lists instruments AND .pc modules

crack_verdict.structure: RESOLVED: full 672-byte layout + exact size identity + record layout equivalence with module INST entries
crack_verdict.open: blk2/blk3 role semantics; whether the 4 tables map 1:1 to SYWT/SYAR/SYAF + one extra (module chunk order: waveforms, ADSR, AMF); player-accurate synth semantics belong to the module RE (nuade) not the container
